provenance.procedure: one teacher-forced forward per sequence; log_softmax of the logits in float32; the log-probability of the actual next token at every position
provenance.placement: device_map=auto, max_memory 90 GiB per device over 4 devices, no offload
provenance.selection:
Rule: the plan below fixes (length, family). For each, take that family's works in order of first
appearance in the file, skipping works already used; join a work's chunks in offset order (a chunk that
does not start where the previous one ended is joined with a blank line); tokenize with the checkpoint's
own tokenizer, no special tokens, as the held-out set is; move to the next work when one runs short;
truncate to exactly the length.
provenance.held_out_disjointness: No shared 16-token windows with independently selected evaluation data.
